## Acceptance criteria

All success criteria are met:

- REQ-1: The graph consumes server-provided hierarchy fields, and `hierarchyResolution.ts` is deleted.
- REQ-2: Node type is read from `GraphNode.type`; no client parsing of `type:` labels remains.
- REQ-3: The TypeScript vector test is removed. [hierarchy_vectors_test.rs](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/tests/hierarchy_vectors_test.rs:55) remains the fixture consumer.
- REQ-4: The recorded `npm-ci` gate passed. Clustering and layout coverage includes hierarchy-only refreshes and repository graph behavior.

## Architecture and separation of concerns

No boundary violations found. The changes are confined to web presentation, payload types, tests, and documentation.

## Functional paradigm

The hierarchy migration uses data projections and collection operations appropriately. No blocking functional-style regression found.

## Correctness and invariants

The prior cache defect is resolved at [GraphView.tsx](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/web/src/components/Graph/GraphView.tsx:809): the layout fingerprint now covers server-provided `type`, `parent`, `children`, `cluster`, and `rank`, as well as visible nodes and edges.

Regression coverage in [GraphView.layoutCache.test.tsx](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/web/src/components/Graph/__tests__/GraphView.layoutCache.test.tsx:145) verifies that hierarchy-only changes trigger layout while presentation-only changes preserve positions.

No Rust persistence, event, gate, assignee, label, or PID behavior changed.

## Safety

No unsafe Rust or PID-sensitive code was introduced.

## Testing

The succeeded `npm-ci` gate is the primary evidence; I did not rerun the web tests. It confirms web lint, tests, and production build passed.

`./scripts/jit-validate.sh` also passed. The working tree changes under `.jit/` are gate-run bookkeeping and were not treated as implementation changes.

## Error handling

No new fallible Rust operations or error-handling regressions were introduced.

## CLI contract

No CLI commands or JSON output contracts changed.

## Documentation

The graph payload documentation and TypeScript model describe the authoritative served fields. No new Rust public API was introduced.

## Prior review feedback

The previous high-severity finding is resolved by the expanded layout-input fingerprint and focused regression tests.

## JIT issue management

Dependency `e486a854` is complete, and the issue reports no unmet dependencies. Repository validation passed.

## Findings

No findings.
